scores.tell: DJ deck body is a puffy pillow slab with soft blob corners and fat rounded knobs; headphones swollen toy-like
Thin tubular legs and straight armrests are mostly right; seat and back slightly soft and pillowy at corners
Cat is a bulbous rounded toy with thick tail and oversized head; very soft blob form, also too glossy-smooth
Faceted star with crisp ridges and tight tips; ball tips slightly large, otherwise clean shape
Truss has thin straight rails and the lamp is a clean cylinder; the lamp bracket is a bit heavy
Saloon doors have flat planar panels and slatted louvers; posts and caps are slightly chunky and the door bottoms are rounded
Snorkel tube is thick and sausage-like; the mask is a soft blob with a rubbery skirt
Telescope tube is straight and thin tripod legs are right; the mount and the rounded cap are a little soft
Palm trunk is stacked fat rings, the fronds are thick, chunky and rubbery, and the coconuts are oversized
Chess table has flat planes and straight edges with tight corners; stools are slightly chunky
